note: The three cubes on the real table. The user states all three are 30 mm; that is what is entered here. It replaces the nominal 25 mm quoted in calib/c920-real-grasp-01/LOG.md, which disagreed with every image: fitting the size as a free parameter (run_realsim.sh measure) gives 30.2-31.4 mm across six archived frames and 30.9 mm on a live one. The ~2% left over between 30.0 and those fits is the camera's, not the block's, and is one of the things an independent position measurement would pin down. Mass and friction below are simulation defaults and have not been measured at all.

tolerances.note: Acceptance thresholds for the estimate, in the table frame. Derived from the block and the gripper: the jaws close on a 30 mm cube with a few mm of lateral slack, so a position error under 5 mm leaves margin, and a yaw error of 10 deg moves a 30 mm cube's corner by 30/2*sqrt(2)*sin(10 deg) = 3.7 mm. Re-derive them for your own gripper before quoting a pass.
